TanStack Router Link.description:
Link to a route; the to prop only accepts paths that exist in the route tree. Requires Link from @tanstack/react-router.

跳转到某个路由，to 只接受路由树中存在的路径；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 Link。

TanStack Router Link with params.description:
Link to a route with a dynamic segment; every segment of the path must appear in params. Requires Link from @tanstack/react-router.

跳转到带动态段的路由，路径中的每个动态段都必须出现在 params 中；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 Link。

TanStack Router Link with search.description:
Link with search params; the object is validated against the target route's validateSearch. Requires Link from @tanstack/react-router.

带 search 参数跳转，对象会按目标路由的 validateSearch 校验；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 Link。

TanStack Router active Link.description:
Link that styles itself while its route is active. Set exact so a parent path does not stay highlighted on child routes. Requires Link from @tanstack/react-router.

路由激活时自带样式的 Link；设置 exact 可避免父路径在子路由下持续高亮；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 Link。

TanStack Router Link preload.description:
Override the router's preloading for one link; intent preloads on hover or focus, viewport when the link is scrolled into view, render immediately, false never.

为单个链接覆盖 router 的预加载策略：intent 悬停或聚焦时预载，viewport 进入视口时预载，render 立即预载，false 不预载。

TanStack Router linkOptions.description:
Declare link options outside JSX while keeping them type-checked against the route tree; spread the result onto a Link. Requires linkOptions from @tanstack/react-router.

在 JSX 之外声明链接选项，同时保持对路由树的类型校验，结果展开到 Link 上；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 linkOptions。
